target: forge.sh pr-close — a foreign-host URL exits non-zero naming the mismatch and makes no request (control: the matching URL sends the PUT)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
fx_http "PUT $P" 200 '{"state":"closed"}'
fx_run pr-close https://evil.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7; fx_show foreign
if printf '%s' "$FX_ERR" | grep -Eqi 'mismatch|differ|does not match|not the configured|foreign|configured'; then echo mismatch-named=yes; else echo mismatch-named=no; fi
echo "puts_before=$(fx_nmeth PUT)"
fx_run pr-close "$U"; fx_show control
echo "puts_after=$(fx_nmeth PUT)"; fx_reqs
fx_done
